title: partners.json
description: Registry of the companies whose name or logo a visual or a copy may show (customers, partners, investors, press), written by the project-context agent to <project>/project-context/partners.json and read through shared/scripts/registry.py. A logo appears only when consent.status is granted and consent.scope covers the use. A company absent from the file is treated as consent unknown: blocked. logo reads on light backgrounds, logo_on_dark on dark ones. Every path is relative to the project-context/ folder. Validate with: python3 shared/scripts/validate_json.py shared/schemas/partners.schema.json <partners.json>, then python3 shared/scripts/registry.py check <project-context>.

name.description: Company name with its exact casing.

relation.description: What the company is to the project.

logo.description: Logo for light backgrounds, under assets/partners/, taken from the company's own site or press kit.

logo_on_dark.description: Logo for dark backgrounds (light ink), e.g. assets/partners/acme-white.svg.

url.description: The company's own site, where the logo was taken from.

scope.description: Uses covered. A granted consent needs at least one.

date.description: Day the consent was given or refused.

source.description: Where it is recorded: 'email of 2026-10-02', 'partnership agreement', 'logo-use clause of the contract'.

rel_path.description: Path relative to the project-context/ folder. Never absolute, never starting with project-context/, never climbing with '..'.
